observations: Photo shows a window/portable-style split AC outdoor/indoor unit? Actually it appears to be a floor-standing AC unit with front grille and top air outlet.
Brand/model text is partially visible on the front panel but not clearly readable in this photo.
The unit has a visible power/connection cable and looks dusty/used.
No clear evidence in the photo that it is faulty (no screen status, no running test, no error code shown).
No remote, no indoor/outdoor pairing parts shown, and no label with exact capacity (BTU) is readable.

claims.claim: Faulty inverter AC available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an AC unit but does not show it powered on, any error code, or any test result confirming the fault.
No photo evidence of Oshodi or any location marker.

risks.risk: Exact AC type/capacity (BTU) and whether it is truly inverter are not readable; wrong capacity/type changes Lagos pricing a lot.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the rating plate/label (brand, model, inverter/non-inverter, BTU, voltage) on the unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used faulty inverter AC with unknown capacity (worst-case for resale).

risks.risk: “Faulty” could be minor (e.g., gas leak, capacitor, fan) or major (compressor dead). Photo cannot confirm compressor condition.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the AC being powered on showing any error behavior (fan starts/doesn’t, compressor sound, blinking codes) and what happens after 5–10 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / compressor likely faulty until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Missing parts or incomplete setup (e.g., no remote, missing indoor/outdoor components, missing installation accessories) can make it unusable.
risks.proof: Photos of everything included: remote (if any), power cable condition, and any split-system matching indoor/outdoor parts (if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs parts until confirmed complete.

risks.risk: Refrigerant/gas condition and leak status are unknown; a unit can be “faulty” due to low gas.
risks.proof: A technician’s test result or a video showing bubbles/leak check or at least confirmation of gas pressure after recharge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing recharge/repair (worst-case) until proven otherwise.

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rating plate/label (brand, model, inverter confirmation, BTU, voltage).
Video of the AC powered on: what starts, any error/blinking code, and whether compressor engages.
Photos of included items (remote, accessories) and confirmation whether it’s a complete split system or a single unit.
If possible: technician report or evidence of gas level/recharge and the specific fault found.
response.reason: The photo shows an AC unit, but the key details needed to price it correctly (exact model/capacity/inverter confirmation) and the fault severity (compressor vs minor issue) are not verifiable from the single image.
